name: Vessor Quillael
keeps: the arithmetic nobody else wants to do
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: Accused of raising the storm that struck James VI’s ship.
text: Vessor quillael of the shut window, keeps the book for the 16th tranche, doors 143 to 152. Keeps the arithmetic nobody else wants to do. Reads John Fian.
